The OODA loop

Observe, orient, decide, act

A decision-making loop for making sense of a changing situation, choosing a response, and learning from what happens next.

01 · ObserveNoticeTake in what is happening.
02 · OrientUnderstandMake sense of the situation.
03 · DecideChoosePick the next move.
04 · ActMovePut the decision into motion.

The proactive future

Turn reports into solutions (Decide)

Give each report to an agent. It works 24/7 and proposes changes for human review.

The point

Fix it before they ask

01Customer experience is moving from reactive help to continuous understanding and action.
02PostHog brings signals together in reports, so support can see what happened, who it affects, and what to do next.
03Agents work on reports 24/7, with a person approving every change before it ships.
